## Experience

### Research Assistant, Koita Centre for Digital Health, Ashoka University
*Dec 2025 – June 2026*

- Designed and ran a simulation study testing whether the order of quality control (QC) steps changes Genome Wide Association Study (GWAS) results. Generated synthetic datasets of 75,000 individuals and ~110,000 SNPs using msprime in R, scripted six QC pipelines in PLINK via Bash, and compared them using SAIGE mixed-model regression across five independently simulated datasets. Reproducible code on [GitHub](http://github.com/sameerareem/).
- Found that QC step order had a negligible effect on GWAS results (Lin's CCC 0.996–1.000), evaluated on genomic inflation, causal-variant recovery, and effect-size concordance.
- Applied two-sample Mendelian Randomization, adapting published code, in an ongoing study of early-life infections and autoimmune disease risk, under Dr. Naveen Kumar Bhatraju.
